# SPACE to switch to orange X, then move to (48, 18)
# From orange X at (18, 27) to (48, 18): DOWN 10, LEFT 3

            o_targets.append(child['boundary'][0])

# Check all targets
all_targets = []
for gs in gray_squares:
    for child_id in gs['children']:
        child = next(n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['id'] == child_id)
